conversationalSummary.text: TODAY there’s probably no reliable window to chase, mainly because the wind looks poor for Meio da Baia and Surfline consistency is pretty lully. There’s a small chance the rising push gives the bay a bit of shape around lunch, but it may still feel soft and inconsistent. I’d check Surfline and MEO Beachcam first and save the drive unless the cams show something clearly cleaner than expected.

best.explanation: Meio da Baia looks like a fun-sized window for Worth checking, Low confidence: 0.6-1.1 m, 67 kJ, 9 s period, lully 19/100, and wind is the main risk.  An inconsistent Baía spot that can work well when north-northwest swell reaches the bay; this is best for bodyboard sessions when the bay is clean, there is enough period and size, and the forecast shows a defined wave; 6-9s at mid tide can make exposed beaches like Belgas / Almagreira / Cerro / Meio da Baia sharp and rippable.  Watch: Surfline consistency is lully; wind angle is poor for this spot; Meio da Baia may feel too soft without more push.
best.shortExplanation: Meio da Baia is worth a quick check for lunch, but it is not a guaranteed session.  Treat it as a check-first call rather than a sure thing.  Wind is the main thing to watch.  The tide and timing are lining up well for this spot.
